# Daily Report — 2026-08-19

## Task Completed
Add survey/assessment tools (`list_assessment_instances`, `get_assessment_instance`,
`list_assessment_metric_types`, `get_assessment_metric_type`) backed by the
`asmt_assessment_instance` and `asmt_metric_type` ServiceNow tables.

Key details:
- `list_assessment_instances` — filters by state, metric_type (name/sys_id),
  user (sys_id or user_name), source_table, and source_id; paginated.
- `get_assessment_instance` — fetch single instance by sys_id; 404 guard.
- `list_assessment_metric_types` — survey/assessment definitions; filters for
  name (substring), active flag, type, and related_table; paginated, ordered by name.
- `get_assessment_metric_type` — fetch by sys_id or exact name; 404 guard.
- `_resolve_metric_type_sys_id` helper — passthrough for 32-char hex, otherwise
  name→sys_id lookup via Table API.
- All reference fields (`metric_type`, `user`, `assigned_to`, `definition`,
  `category`) normalised to display values.
- Registered in `__init__.py`, `tool_utils.py`, `tool_packages.yaml`
  (system_administrator and full packages).
